VAR-lstatus.why: Self-defined current economic status with employed/unemployed/inactive categories suitable to derive labor status (7-day ref).
Self-defined current activity status (at work / looking / retired / other inactive) alternative source for labor status.

VAR-lstatusyear.why: Self-defined current economic status; can support 12-month labor status construction.
Self-defined current activity status (at work / looking / inactive) alternative for 12-month labor status.

VAR-nlfreason.why: Includes student/education, domestic tasks, retired, disabled, other inactive categories matching NLF reasons.

VAR-nlfreasonyear.why: Includes detailed inactive categories (education, retired, disabled, domestic, other) usable for 12-month NLF reason.

VAR-empstat.why: Employment status in the main job (employee/casual/employer/self-employed/unpaid family worker) aligns with primary-job employment status.

VAR-empstatyear.why: Employment status in the main job; candidate for primary-job status for 12-month ref.

VAR-contract.why: Type of contract of employees in the main job (permanent/temporary/etc.); candidate for contract (yes/no) in primary job.

VAR-contractyear.why: Type of contract of employees in the main job; candidate for 12-month contract indicator.

VAR-occup.why: Occupation code of the main job (ISCO-08 major groups 1–9) matches 1-digit occupation classification for primary job.

VAR-occupyear.why: Occupation code of the main job (ISCO-08 major groups 1–9); candidate for 12-month primary occupation.

VAR-industrycat10.why: Economic activity of local unit of the main job (NACE Rev.2 sections 1–18) matches 1-digit industry category for primary job.

VAR-industrycat10year.why: Economic activity of local unit of the main job (NACE Rev.2 sections) candidate for 12-month primary industry category.

VAR-industrycat4.why: NACE Rev.2 section for main job could be collapsed to 4-category industry (Agriculture/Industry/Services/Other).

VAR-industrycat4year.why: NACE Rev.2 section for main job could be collapsed to 4-category industry for 12-month ref.

VAR-ocusec.why: Workplace status Public vs Private; candidate for sector of activity in primary job.

VAR-ocusecyear.why: Workplace status Public vs Private; candidate for sector of activity in primary job (12-month).

VAR-socialsec.why: Registration status to social security institutions in the main job; candidate for social security coverage (primary job).

VAR-socialsecyear.why: Registration status to social security institutions in the main job; candidate for social security coverage (12-month).

VAR-whours.why: Total number of hours usually worked in main job; candidate for hours worked last week in primary job.

VAR-whoursyear.why: Total number of hours usually worked in main job; candidate for hours worked for 12-month ref (may need annualization/assumption).

VAR-thoursothers.why: Total number of hours usually worked in additional job/jobs; candidate for hours in other jobs (excl. primary/secondary).

VAR-thoursothersyear.why: Total number of hours usually worked in additional job/jobs; candidate for other-jobs hours for 12-month ref (may need annualization).

VAR-wmonths.why: Number of months spent in the main job in 2023; candidate for months worked in last 12 months (primary job).
Number of months spent at last work in 2023; fallback candidate if main job not present / job ended.

VAR-wmonthsyear.why: Number of months spent in the main job in 2023; candidate for months worked (12-month ref).
Number of months spent at last work in 2023; fallback candidate if using last job for 12-month measures.

VAR-unempldurl.why: Number of months spent in unemployment in 2023; candidate to derive unemployment duration (lower/upper bracket) for 7-day ref.

VAR-unemplduru.why: Number of months spent in unemployment in 2023; candidate to derive unemployment duration (upper bracket) for 7-day ref.

VAR-unempldurlyear.why: Number of months spent in unemployment in 2023; candidate to derive unemployment duration (lower bracket) for 12-month ref.

VAR-unemplduruyear.why: Number of months spent in unemployment in 2023; candidate to derive unemployment duration (upper bracket) for 12-month ref.

VAR-wagetotal.why: Net annual income from main job in 2023; candidate proxy for annualized total wage (primary job).

VAR-wagetotalyear.why: Net annual income from main job in 2023; candidate for annualized total wage (primary job, 12-month ref).

VAR-lincnc.why: Annual net employee cash/near-cash income received in 2023; candidate component for total wage income excl bonuses.
Annual net employee income in 2023 (second employee income item); candidate component for wage income excl bonuses.
Net annual income from main job in 2023; alternative wage-income source.

VAR-laborincome.why: Annual net employee cash/near-cash income in 2023; component for total labor income.
Annual net employee income in 2023; component for total labor income.
Annual net self-employment income in cash in 2023; component for total labor income.
Annual net self-employment income in kind in 2023; component for total labor income.
Net annual income from main job in 2023; alternative labor-income source.
Net annual income from last job in 2023; possible additional component when main job absent.
